_comment: Voice-channel device table (docs/voice-channel.md in briefing-table). Static name; hot-reloaded by server.py on change. `device` ids are the roster names the bridge uses. `mode` is the P3 dev-mode flag (chat|development). `room` feeds the origin envelope for location-aware personas later. `announce_url` is the Dot bridge's loopback ingress — never a tailnet URL.

voice_mqtt._comment: MQTT announcer: publish a deliver body as JSON on `topic`; outcome comes back on `<ack_topic>/<replyId>`. Broker = NUC mosquitto (tailnet IP). Remove `broker` to disable.

voice_engine._comment: briefing-table engine (dev-mode inbound). Bearer v2v presents is read per call from token_path (sealed-delivered; NOT a caller key). reply_to is what the engine calls back for the spoken reply. reply_to uses the VRPC tailnet IP: the NUC has no MagicDNS for vrpc-3.tail567253.ts.net.
